# Curated references

<!-- Generated by `aiwh references --markdown`; edit capabilities/references/catalog.json instead. -->

Public references curated from reviewed sources. They are evaluation candidates, not endorsements;
nothing is installed, cloned or executed by AI Workbench. Descriptions are self-reported by authors.
Reviewed is the date the entry was last read by a maintainer, with the license its README stated then;
`-` means no review date is recorded.

## Risk labels

- `authorized-only`: Use only on systems, software, devices, models or accounts you own or have written permission to test.
- `tos-check`: May conflict with provider or platform terms of service; review terms before use.
- `licensing-check`: May involve copyrighted content or unclear licensing; use only with content you are entitled to.
- `experimental`: Self-described or observed as experimental; verify claims before relying on it.
- `financial-risk`: Research/simulation reference; not financial advice. Live trading needs separate risk review and approval.
